correctness.rationale: The equal-output pair graph has 256 ordered 4-bit-window pairs; a length-N closed walk through an off-diagonal vertex is equivalent to two distinct ring configurations with equal output. For an off-diagonal cyclic SCC, eventual closed-walk lengths are the positive multiples of its gcd graph period; absence on all odd N iff every such period is even, and absence for N≡2 mod4 iff periods are multiples of four. This gives a FINITE exact criterion for the infinite quantified claim. Inspected entire shipped C verifier, then independently implemented and compiled an independent C graph-period census over all 65,472 degree-two coefficient masks, reproducing exactly 32/8 and ALL supplied mask identities. Independent Python truth tables mapped four 3-site progressions times the eight ECA rules to the accepted set. The positive cases are already known ECA reversibles, shifted/doubled on odd rings. The exact census, not sample finite sizes, certifies exclusion.
